mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active and does not require threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) rise by more than 200k in the past month, it signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS rise > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS rise > 200k, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust household demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal fails if either series declines.
failure_condition: The signal fails when either RSAFS or HOUST declines, and 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals central bank response to inflation, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS declines, but 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 150,000 thousand, it indicates a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns when PAYEMS > 150,000 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) is below 1.5%, it signals an economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 and GDPC1 < 1.5% (QoQ), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates accommodative monetary policy combined with strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal requires both conditions to be met for strength.
failure_condition: The signal fails when either FEDFUNDS does not decline or RSAFS does not increase, and 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 3 months), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals sector recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is inactive in manufacturing boom regimes.
failure_condition: The signal fails when INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 3 months but HOUST does not rise, and 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such cases.
